content: ES module imports are live bindings (references, not copies). In circular-import cycles, ESM evaluates modules in post-order (child before parent); a binding is in the temporal dead zone until its source module finishes initializing. Reading a not-yet-initialized top-level const/let/class binding during the cycle throws ReferenceError. Circular deps are safe only when the cross-reference is deferred into function/method bodies (resolved lazily at call time) rather than evaluated at module top level.
